positions.title: Administrative Assistant
positions.description:
- Producing high-quality documents, spreadsheets and presentations for the admissions team. While executing a record filing system to improve document organization and management; handled applicants correspondence and tracked records to foster office efficiency.
- Uploading incoming documents from applicants into their applicant files online, as well as uploading a copy of everything onto Excel to ensure organization and security.

positions.title: Social Media Marketing Intern
positions.description:
- Coordinated with other teams in the office to create their desired graphic using Canva to post and manage on all of our social media accounts.
- Manage content, develop media plans and update social media, including Facebook and Twitter, with a focus on increasing awareness and engagement.

positions.title: Campus Ambassador
positions.description: - Recruiting at least 10-15 Berkeley students a month to join TWN, as well as constantly promoting our national events to increase engagement amongst members.
positions.insights: Skills: Community Outreach · Recruiting · Graphic Design

positions.title: Summer Intern
positions.description:
- Identified learning needs and implemented fun and engaging learning activities to help students advance. Collaborated with students to complete homework assignments, identify lagging skills and correct weaknesses.
- Chose materials and developed lesson plans to enhance skills for individual students. Encouraged creative thinking and motivated students by addressing individual strengths and weaknesses based on standardized testing results

positions.title: Finance Assistant
positions.description:
- Applied proper codes to invoices, files and receipts to keep records organized and easily searchable. While reporting financial data and updated financial records in ledgers and journals.
- Managed office inventory and ordered new supplies when items were running low. Assessed data and information to verify entry, calculation and billing code accuracy.
- Greeted visitors and customers upon arrival, offered assistance and answered questions to build rapport and retention.
